data.long_description:
Live the Dream at La Vie, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR).

Step into your ideal blend of luxury and beachfront serenity at La Vie. This stunning 3-bedroom + maid’s room residence is your gateway to an unparalleled lifestyle.

Property Highlights:
- 3 Spacious Bedrooms + Maid's Room
- 4 Stylish Bathrooms
- High Floor with Spectacular Views
- Floor-to-ceiling Windows & Private Balcony
- Breathtaking Sea Views
- Approx. 1,964 sqft
- Private Beach Access
- 2 Reserved Parking Spaces

Inspired by Miami’s Modernist Architecture:
A masterpiece of sleek design, panoramic windows, and elevated interiors, La Vie redefines sophistication.
Exclusive Amenities:
- Private Beach Access
- Resort-style Swimming Pool with Sea Views
- Fully Equipped Gym
- Sauna & Steam Rooms
- Children’s Play Area
- Outdoor Leisure Spaces
- 24/7 Security & Concierge Services
Prime Location:
Nestled in Dubai’s most prestigious waterfront community, enjoy:
-The serene Arabian Gulf just steps away
- Proximity to Dubai Marina, The Walk, and world-class shopping
- Easy access to schools and public transport

The La Vie Lifestyle: Where luxury, comfort, and convenience unite to create your perfect home.
